level_interpretation.note: Values are copied as reported in metres. The file does not state the datum; compare with RL_of_zeroGauge before interpreting them as gauge height or reduced level.

notes: Raw telemetry: values are not quality-controlled by this converter.

trend.method: Latest observation compared with the earliest observation within the preceding 3.0 h window.

qc.reference: Prototype QC derived from rwl_tel_hr_cwc_009_2021_2025.csv (not official). Smooth, physically plausible runs stay within 71.0-75.2 m; values outside 70-80 m (e.g. 1-3 m in early 2021, 100-1070 m spikes) are telemetry errors. 72.0 m repeats exactly 4059 times, in runs up to 1084 h and between 73.0x m readings, so it is treated as a fill value. Corrupted readings typically jump by whole metres, hence max_jump_m 1.0.

threshold_evaluation.reason: No warning/danger thresholds are configured for this station. No official values are assumed.
